AVX2 BLAKE3 compression for batched hashing and LtHash output.

# Purpose
This C file implements AVX-based BLAKE3 compression routines. The main entry point, [`fd_blake3_avx_compress8`](<#fd_blake3_avx_compress8>), processes up to 8 message lanes in parallel and handles normal hashing, parent-node hashing, and LtHash output mode. It prepares tail blocks for messages that are not a multiple of 64 bytes, sets per-block flags and counters, loads message words into AVX vectors, and runs the BLAKE3 round function with SIMD operations. After compression, it stores either 32-byte chaining values or 64-byte extended output, depending on `out_sz`.

The file also defines [`fd_blake3_avx_compress8_fast`](<#fd_blake3_avx_compress8_fast>), a fixed-shape helper for the common case where all 8 lanes have the same block structure. It loads 8 parallel blocks directly from a contiguous message layout, applies the same BLAKE3 round logic, and writes the final chaining values to the output buffer. The file depends on internal BLAKE3 headers and AVX helper types and functions, and it exposes low-level compression APIs for use by the wider BLAKE3 implementation.
